displayName: Allow the Serial API on specific sites
description: Specifies URL patterns for sites that are allowed to request access to a serial port. If not configured, Microsoft Edge uses the value from the DefaultSerialGuardSetting policy (if set), or the user's settings. For unmatched sites, the following order applies: 1. "SerialBlockedForUrls" (if matched). 2. DefaultSerialGuardSetting (if set). 3. User's settings. If URL patterns in this policy conflict with those in "SerialBlockedForUrls", they're ignored. For detailed information about valid URL patterns, please see https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2095322.
